description: Return the comprehensive creator context bundle for one creator space: knowledge docs, voice profile, AI analyses, integrations, interviews, LinkedIn profile/posts/analytics, website, website screenshot, brand kits, media, and REST/MCP availability notes. Sections are scope-gated and report omitted sections when the key lacks a read scope.

sections.description: Optional subset. Omit to load all sections the key can read.
